call_points.text: Management continues to guide for stand-alone operating margins of around 45% on an annual basis.
Average client funding book reached a record ₹74.5 billion, up about 40.5% year-on-year.
45-50% margin guidance remains intact, on a standalone basis; consolidated margins were healthy after IPL adjustments.
Normalised EBDAT margin was 43.6% against 44.4% in the previous quarter, after IPL spend, increments and ESOP grants.
Client funding book reached a record ₹7,150 Cr at period end; average book was ₹6,140 Cr.
Board approved a first interim dividend of ₹1 per share, record date July 21, 2026.
Loan against securities is in a small pilot; management expects it to become big in the next two or three quarters.
Analysts pressed on the credit slowdown; management cited lender underwriting and pricing changes and funnel friction, and declined to give a quarterly target.
Management declined to comment on July volumes or the RBI circular's impact, saying it does not discuss mid-quarter trends.
Cash realisation rose to about ₹19 from ₹15-16 earlier, driven by ticket-size mix and a value-added assisted plan.
Employee costs for FY27 guided to be flat YoY at ~₹1,100 Cr including ESOPs.
Proposed ₹150 Cr capital infusion each into Wealth and NBFC businesses to drive scale.
Average daily orders recovered to 7.4 million in March 2026 from 5 million in Feb 2025.
NBFC to launch Loan Against Securities (LAS) on its own balance sheet.
AI now generates 80% of Ionic Wealth's codebase, accelerating innovation cycles.
RBI directions on bank capital market exposure may tighten intraday credit, requiring more bank guarantees.

operating_notes.text: Ionic Wealth AUM crossed ₹10,000 Cr in Q4FY26.
Lifetime cumulative credit disbursements reached ₹2,710 Cr.
Average daily orders reached 7.4 million in March 2026.
April 2026 client base reached 37.79 Mn with overall ADTO at ₹52,210 Bn.
May 2026 average client funding book reached an all-time high of ₹6,309 Cr, up 57.5% YoY.
May 2026 commodity turnover market share fell to 48.6% from 56.5% a year earlier.
May 2026 F&O premium turnover market share rose to 22.4% from 21.4% a year earlier.
Equity derivatives turnover market share was 22.2%, cash equity turnover share 17.4% and overall retail equity turnover share 20.2% in Q1FY27.
Interest income was 32.6% of gross revenue at ₹470 Cr, up 2.6% sequentially, on the client funding book.
Cash realisation rose to close to ₹19 from ₹15-16 earlier, driven by ticket-size mix and a value-added assisted plan.
IPL sponsorship and related expenses were ₹1,366.63 million in H1FY27 against ₹1,267.25 million for the whole of FY26.
Loans on the consolidated balance sheet rose to ₹79,582.26 million at 30 September 2026 from ₹51,280.67 million at 31 March 2026.
Debt equity ratio was 1.13 times at 30 September 2026 against 1.28 times at 31 March 2026.
Client funding book reached ₹82.1 Bn as on September 30, 2026, with 82% of the book aged under 30 days.
Unique SIPs registered reached 1.9 Mn in Q2 FY27, while total mutual fund ever users stood at ~3.7 Mn.
Credit distributed in Q2 FY27 was ₹6.9 Bn, up 30.2% QoQ, with 179k+ lifetime credit users.
Average client funding book reached ₹74.5 bn in Q2 FY27, up 40.5% YoY.

timeline.summary: Angel One reported a 19% QoQ rise in Q4 PAT to ₹320 Cr, driven by record order volumes and AI-led cost efficiencies.
Angel One's May 2026 update showed client base at 38.17 Mn (+19.5% YoY) and an all-time-high average client funding book of ₹63.09 Bn, while commodity market share fell 786 bps YoY to 48.6%.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹1,426.99 Cr (+18.7% YoY), net profit ₹334.97 Cr (+58.2% YoY).
Board of Directors declared Interim Dividend of Rs. 1.40 per equity share effective October 15, 2026.
Angel One released its Q2 FY27 investor presentation highlighting PAT growth of 58.2% YoY and funding book reaching ₹8,212 Cr.
Angel One reported Q2 FY27 consolidated revenue of ₹1,431.5 Cr and net profit of ₹335 Cr, reflecting 58.2% YoY growth.
Audio recording of earnings call with analysts and investors made available on Angel One Limited’s website on October 16, 2026.
Angel One hosted its Q2FY27 earnings conference call on October 16, 2026, reporting an 18.9% YoY increase in consolidated gross revenue and a 58.2% surge in PAT.
